thread:
anna: FYI I opened a docs PR proposing a standard deprecation flow for model variants + aliasing guidance (for customers using pinned variants). PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/812

raj: Nice. What are the core pieces?

anna: Short summary in the PR: recommended deprecation banner text, 90-day deprecation window, an aliasing pattern (alias -> canonical variant) so SDKs can map deprecated names, and a migration checklist for product teams. Also added a tiny SDK shim example that maps aliases client-side and falls back to compatible variants.

lena: Can you paste the SDK snippet? Want to ensure it matches our SDK naming conventions.

anna: Snippet in PR (pseudo):

```python
ALIAS_MAP = { 'orion-old': 'orion-v1', 'orion-quant': 'orion-v1-quant' }
client = RedwoodClient()
def resolve_variant(name):
    return ALIAS_MAP.get(name, name)
resp = client.generate(model=resolve_variant(requested_variant), prompt=...)
```

omar: Suggest we show a server-side redirect pattern too in the docs (model-catalog redirect) so hosted customers get automatic mapping without client changes. Also add a note for Dedicated: if a customer pins a variant that's deprecated, they need explicit human ops to migrate; automated aliasing won't change provisioned pools.

raj: Add a short compatibility table: deprecated -> replacement, expected latency/cost delta, known quirk notes (e.g., quantized variant loses fp16 kernels). That helps PD teams decide.

anna: Good call. I added a small example row: orion-old -> orion-v1, latency +5ms token on avg, cost +2%. Also included wording for the deprecation banner and a short migration checklist: export pinned configs, test fallback, schedule maintenance window if Dedicated, update infra pins.

lena: Also call out telemetry hooks: add eval prompts to the rollout to catch subtle drift. And ensure SDK logs a deprecation warning once per process.
